description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Consumer Affairs Authority Act No. 09 of 2003 (Amended) Direction under Section 10(1)(b)(ii)
categorisation: This gazette contains a regulatory direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes a prohibition on importing, selling, or using rice/paddy for animal feed manufacture, which constitutes a regulatory matter. The content involves legal/regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial registrations, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories.
